page.overview:
Who is Ahmed?

Ahmed (Arabic: أحمد) is a minor character in the 1974 film The Man With The Golden Gun. He was played by Rocky Taylor.

The three thugs, Ahmed, Rahman, and their boss, observe Bond who is viewing a dancer, Saida, in a bar. They tail Bond who is on his to way to the the dancer's dressing room, on his way to retrieve a golden bullet which killed 002 that was seen on the dancer. With the three thugs finding Bond in the dressing room, a fight begins, with the thugs eventually managing to strike Bond from behind causing him to swallow the bullet. After the brutal brawl ends, the three thugs are rendered unconscious by Bond.
